messages:
anya.design: Quick design check — current suppression preview is confusing. It shows the suppressed badge but still lists channels beneath. QA read it as 'this will notify these channels' which is wrong.

liam.eng: Agreed. Behavior should be: preview = final computed recipients given active policies. If suppression yields an empty set, the preview should show that explicitly.

marta-product: Proposed copy idea: headline 'Notifications suppressed' and secondary line 'No channels will be notified while suppression is active.' Short, clear.

samir-ux: I like headline + subline. Also we need a distinct state for 'suppression with fallback' where some critical channels bypass suppression. That should show 'Fallback: #ops' not the full channel list.

kelly-accessibility: Accessibility nits: voiceover currently reads the badge then still focuses channel list. We must ensure aria-live reads a single, consistent sentence like: 'Notifications suppressed. No recipients will be notified.' or 'Notifications suppressed. Fallback to channel: Ops.' Also do not rely on color alone for the badge.

ci-bot: deploy-preview: UI update pushed to staging -> https://staging.redwood/design/preview-298 (screenshot uploaded).

anya.design: CSS nit from the screenshot: suppression pill (12px) fails AA contrast on light theme. Options: increase font-size to 14px or use weight 600. Also spacing — pill should align with threshold row baseline.

liam.eng: Implementation detail: we can add preview.mode = `final` or `computed`. `final` shows post-policy recipients; `computed` can show pre-suppression candidate list for debugging. Default should be `final` for end-users.

marta-product: Product decision: default `final` and an optional toggle 'Show computed recipients' tucked into the preview overflow menu for power users.

samir-ux: UX idea: instead of expanding the whole preview for fallback channels, show a micro tooltip/icon: ⚠️ 'Fallback to 1 channel' -> microdrawer with reason + config link. Keeps compactness.

kelly-accessibility: Keyboard flow: tab order must land on the suppression pill, then the microtooltip trigger. Enter on pill should open the details. For screen readers, ensure the pill has role=button and `aria-pressed` state for manual suppression.

anya.design: Updated copy proposals uploaded in the staging screenshot:
- Active suppression (no fallback): 'Notifications suppressed' / 'No channels will be notified'
- Active suppression (fallback exists): 'Notifications suppressed' / 'Fallback: #ops will still be notified'
- Scheduled suppression: 'Suppression scheduled: Apr 1, 09:00 — Apr 1, 17:00'

liam.eng: I'll wire the API flag and add `preview.summary` payload to the preview endpoint: { mode, headline, subline, fallbackChannels } (implementation note only).

marta-product: Requesting quick sign-off from design + accessibility: thumbs up if we ship this to staging with the copy and aria changes by EOD.

samir-ux: :+1: from me. The microtooltip pattern looks good.

kelly-accessibility: :+1: with the aria-live and contrast fixes. Also recommend adding a test case in VoiceOver CI for the three suppression states.

anya.design: Thanks everyone — I'll land the design patch and update the staging screenshot. Will ping once the contrast/keyboard tweaks are in.

ci-bot: note: staging preview will auto-update when the PR is merged.
